title: Merge Sort
statement:
Given an array of integers, sort the array using the merge sort algorithm.

Merge sort is a divide-and-conquer algorithm that divides the input array into two halves, calls itself for the two halves, and then merges the two sorted halves.

editorial.approach: Merge sort works by recursively dividing the array into two halves until each subarray contains a single element, then merging those subarrays in sorted order.
editorial.complexity: O(n log n) time / O(n) space
